description: Complete catalog of official public, governmental, school, bank, workday, Christian, and Hebrew holidays of Algeria (الجزائر) — extracted from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation. الجزائر/Al-Jaza'ir (Algeria). People's Democratic Republic of Algeria — independence 1962. Country code: DZ. Categories: christian, hebrew, public. Multilingual names (3 languages: ar, en_US, fr). End-of-string `(estimated)/(observed)` parentheticals stripped from name columns and lifted into per-record `is_estimated`/`is_observed` boolean flags (per-language regex). No subdivisions — single national list.
